description: Specification detail x test access, a 2x2 factorial at stages 1-10 on image 0.4 (revised oracle, bash default timeout, last-buildable co-primary). Specification: the full behavioral specification (starter baseline) vs a minimal one that gives only the product interface and a one-line-per-stage feature list. Tests: on demand through test_visible with failure-level reports (starter baseline) vs withheld. The four cells are the starter baseline, spec-minimal, tests-none, and spec-minimal-tests-none; every other factor is held at the starter baseline.
